short.title_plain: Buto: Hidden Saite Structure Found from Space
short.hook: A 2,600-year-old Saite-era structure beneath Buto was found from space.
script: A 2,600-year-old Saite-era structure beneath Buto was found from space.
It spans 420 feet and sits beneath a mound of waterlogged clay.
Deep underground, researchers found a thick layer of clean sand — not just dirt, but a deliberate foundation.
This sand cushion stopped clay from swelling and protected mudbrick walls from water damage.
The site also held ushabti figurines and a baboon statue linked to the god Thoth.
Ancient builders used sand like modern engineers — a smart, tested solution.
Tap the link below for the full case file.
short.description:
A massive 2,600-year-old Saite-era structure was detected beneath Buto, Egypt, using satellite radar and electrical resistivity tomography. Researchers found a thick layer of clean sand at 20 to 23 feet underground, possibly used as a foundation to prevent clay from swelling and damaging mudbrick walls. The site also contained ushabti figurines and a baboon statue linked to Thoth. The discovery reflects advanced understanding of local geology. Source: Live Science, https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/ancient-egyptians/buried-for-2-600-years-beneath-nile-mud-a-massive-ancient-egyptian-complex-was-just-found-from-space
Full case file: https://youtu.be/0oxRyjMgIBU
